name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Cross-Functional Program & Operations Manager
summary: Operations and program-execution professional with 15+ years translating ambiguous business priorities into structured plans, owners, and timelines across marketing, CRM, and cross-functional delivery teams. Built and maintain 20+ production automation workflows end to end, coordinate concurrent workstreams for a multi-client portfolio, and keep decisions and follow-through documented so nothing depends on memory. Comfortable working across stakeholders with different priorities, escalating risks early, and building the repeatable operating rhythms that let a team move faster with less ambiguity.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Coordinate cross-functional workstreams across CRM, SEO, paid media, and content for a concurrent client portfolio, translating strategic priorities into scoped deliverables, owners, and timelines.
Document every client engagement, workflow, and configuration decision in Notion, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, keeping project records auditable and follow-through visible across concurrent engagements.
Break down ambiguous business requirements into structured automation logic and implementation steps, acting as the translation layer between non-technical stakeholders and technical execution.
Monitor 20+ production automation workflows for breaks between lead sources and downstream systems, identifying and resolving issues before they affect delivery.
Build performance dashboards and deliver reporting on a regular cadence, surfacing risks, blockers, and recommendations rather than just activity.
Identify process gaps and build repeatable operating rhythms, evolving how engagements are scoped, tracked, and delivered as the client portfolio grows.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across inbound, paid media, and content workstreams as strategic lead, aligning internal departments and client stakeholders around shared priorities.
Built reporting frameworks and led Quarterly Business Reviews that translated channel performance into leadership-ready updates on progress, risk, and next steps.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, keeping delivery on track and resolving feedback promptly to protect timelines.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed onboarding and technical setup for 15-20 reseller partners concurrently, standardizing communication workflows and training sequences to reduce friction and keep timelines on track.
Tracked partner utilization and adoption data to identify risk and resource constraints early, escalating with recommended interventions rather than waiting for churn.
Shared structured, high-priority feedback with Product and Engineering, keeping cross-functional partners aligned on dependencies affecting the roadmap.
Retained all but one partner in the book (~94% retention) during tenure through proactive account management and clear follow-through.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed a team of onboarding specialists, standardizing process and QA checkpoints to keep concurrent client launches on schedule and accountable.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month while reaching 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets, coordinating scope, budget, and delivery for each account.
Drove process improvements and documentation for a new Wix vertical that moved from proof of concept to a profitable business line, including hiring and training new hires.
Led onboarding and launch operations as primary point of contact, accelerating time-to-value through clear ownership and consistent follow-through.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, then handed structured specs to the delivery team to execute against.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, troubleshooting technical configuration directly with C-suite stakeholders.
Escalated account-level risk to leadership early, with clear options and recommended paths forward.
Advised clients on CRM adoption and scalable operating systems aligned to their growth stage and team structure.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance-marketing agency, coordinating campaign execution, reporting, and cross-team communication.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery teams.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
